protocol: Same pair-join-empirical-test.py: 20 scenarios × N=5 × 3 probes. Compare lift + per-scenario shape.

reading: qwen3's aggregate lift 1.14 does not survive cross-model. On gemma3 and qwen2.5:1.5b the 2×2 collapses to a single margin (CD-only vs route-only), so lift is undefined — itself evidence that 'independent detectors' was a within-model description.
The load-bearing DS4 co-fire cell reverses: qwen3 3/5 both; gemma3 0/5 route / 4/5 CD; qwen2.5 0 MISSes on DS4.
DF6/DS5 'neither' pocket is also model-bound: qwen3 had 9; gemma3 caught 0 there (no MISSes); qwen2.5 had 1 DF6 miss caught by route alone.
SUPPORT Mike: close within-model before trusting n. Cross-model pair-join refuses 'independent in general'.
honest_limits: gemma3 and qwen2.5:1.5b each produce only 5 MISSes — too thin for a second lift estimate; the claim rests on shape/margin reversal, not a second lift≈1.
